title: 第7章 小墨第8章 宋虎第9章 宋家来袭
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
叶辰平静的走向宋虎，一剑挑飞了宋虎的头，潇洒的将紫霄剑插回了剑鞘，自顾自的走了，丝毫不在意围观的众人，脸上看不出一丝的波澜，就好像什么事情都没有发生一样。
围观的众人惊呆了，失神了，大家都静悄悄的，两息后，众人才反应过来，叶辰早已离去，只能看见模糊的背影，突然有一人惊叫了起来“宋虎死了，这可是宋家的独苗啊！”
宋家的大长老宋慈赶了过来，看着满地的尸体，抱着宋虎的躯体，怒吼道“叶辰小儿，我要将你碎尸万段”。
吩咐护卫将一众尸体抬回家中，好生安葬。
宋慈急忙先行回到家中，向家主宋幕云禀告。
“家主，一定要将叶辰小儿抓住，为虎儿报仇雪恨”。
宋慕云红着眼看着宋慈“二弟，叫上三弟四弟，带上护卫，我们去找叶青云要人”
众人来到叶家门口，护卫见宋家来势汹汹，急忙跑去禀告大长老
“禀告大长老，宋家家主及三位长老来到府门口闹事”
大长老淡淡的说“知道了，你去通知二长老和三长老到府门口集合”。
叶青云缓缓的向府门口走去。
片刻功夫，叶青云来到府门口，平静的道
“宋家主，今日带着众人来我叶家有何贵干啊？”
“叶青云，交出杀害我儿的凶手叶辰！”宋幕云怒吼道
“这小杂种，竟会给我惹事生非，今日人多眼杂，自然不能交出叶辰，日后再找机会废掉这小杂种”叶青云心里嘀咕着
看着宋幕云淡淡的道“叶辰乃我叶家少家主，我们不可能交出叶辰，武道世界，实力为尊.况且，今日玲珑商会门前发生了什么事情，大家都心知肚明。宋虎仗势欺人，以多欺少，不曾想技不如人，又怎么能怪得了别人”
“宋家主不会想打了小的来了老的，以大欺小吧！”叶青云轻蔑的笑道
“哼，今日你交不交出叶辰”宋幕云目露凶光，双拳紧了紧，似是一言不合准备开战
“怎么宋家主，准备开战”叶青云不屑的看着对方
叶辰此时也出来了调侃道

“怎么打了小的来了老的”
“小杂种，还我儿命来”宋幕云，看见叶辰后，情绪失控，不顾一切的朝叶辰袭来
雄浑而狂暴的灵力铺天盖地的向叶辰宣泄，两息间轰出了几百拳，顿时，飞沙走石，尘土飞扬，宋幕云的金刚伏虎拳已有大成，威力狂暴而且攻击范围广
叶青云本就盯着宋幕云，看见宋幕云含怒一击，自己根本当不住全部的攻击，慢了一瞬，一把盘龙枪使出，两息间竟也挥出了百十道枪芒，这是这是一百零八路的惊涛拍浪枪法，黄级上品枪法，也已大成，逼退了宋幕云，并抵挡了大部分拳风
很多护卫和家丁还是被拳风击倒，很多人也口吐鲜血
叶辰被重点袭击，一名炼气境九重天的攻击，确实给叶辰造成了很大的伤害，狂吐几口血，倒地恢复了一刻钟，缓缓的站起身来
“老狗，以大欺小，也不过如此，今日之仇，小爷日后一定会报”
“哼，小杂种，今日我必要将你碎尸万段”宋幕云恶狠狠的盯着叶辰。
“大哥，现在和叶家开战实属不智，叶家和我们实力相当，家族开战只会是两败俱伤，我们回去另寻他法”宋家二长老，宋多星，人称智多星，足智多谋
宋幕云看着宋多星，脸色恢复些许平静，宋虎死后，宋幕云急火攻心，此时冷静下来。
“叶青云，我宋家与叶家势不两立，我们走着瞧”宋幕云含怒离去
叶青云走过来望着叶辰，假惺惺的关心
“辰儿，没事吧！”
“多谢大伯关心，辰儿无事，休息两日便可痊愈”，叶辰平静的回道
“那好，你多加休息，别忘了家族大比”
叶青云说完转身回去了。
叶辰暗道“你想把我赶出家门，他日我一定给你一个惊喜”
也不管周围人的目光，转身回到了自己的小院
content_en:
Ye Chen calmly walked towards Song Hu, knocked off Song Hu's head with a sword, put the Zixiao Sword back into its scabbard gracefully, and walked away without paying any attention to the people watching. There was no trace of emotion on his face, as if nothing happened.
The onlookers were stunned and lost their minds. Everyone was silent. After two breaths, everyone realized that Ye Chen had left long ago and could only see his blurry back. Suddenly one person exclaimed, "Song Hu is dead. This is the only child of the Song family!"
Song Ci, the eldest elder of the Song family, rushed over, looked at the corpses on the ground, hugged Song Hu's body, and roared, "My dear Ye Chen, I will cut you into pieces."
He ordered the guards to carry all the corpses back home for burial.
Song Ci hurriedly returned home and reported to the head of the family, Song Muyun.
"Master, we must capture Ye Chen's son and avenge Hu'er."
Song Muyun looked at Song Ci with red eyes, "Second brother, call the third and fourth brothers and bring the guards. Let's go find Ye Qingyun to ask for someone."
Everyone came to the door of Ye's house. Seeing the Song family's menacing attack, the guards hurriedly ran to report to the elder.
"Report to the First Elder that the head of the Song family and three elders came to the gate to cause trouble."
The first elder said calmly, "I understand, you go and inform the second elder and the third elder to gather at the gate of the house."
Ye Qingyun slowly walked towards the door of the mansion.
After a while, Ye Qingyun came to the door of the house and said calmly
"Master Song, why are you bringing everyone to my Ye family today?"
"Ye Qingyun, hand over Ye Chen, the murderer of my son!" Song Muyun roared angrily.
"This little bastard can actually cause trouble for me. There are many people today, so naturally I can't hand over Ye Chen. I will find an opportunity to destroy this little bastard in the future." Ye Qingyun muttered in his heart.
Looking at Song Muyun, he said calmly, "Ye Chen is the young master of my Ye family. We can't hand over Ye Chen. In the world of martial arts, strength is respected. Besides, everyone knows what happened in front of the Linglong Chamber of Commerce today. Song Hu uses his power to bully others, using more to bully the less. He never thought that his skills are inferior to others, so how can he blame others?"
"The head of the Song family wouldn't want to beat the younger one, so let's use the older one to bully the younger one!" Ye Qingyun said with a contemptuous smile.
"Hmph, are you going to hand over Ye Chen today?" Song Muyun's eyes flashed fiercely, and he clenched his fists, as if he was ready to start a war after a disagreement.
"Why, Master Song, are you ready to start a war?" Ye Qingyun looked at the other party with disdain.
Ye Chen also came out at this time and joked:
"Why did you hit the younger one and the older one came?"
"You little bastard, give back my son's life." Song Muyun lost control of his emotions after seeing Ye Chen and attacked Ye Chen desperately.
The majestic and violent spiritual power was overwhelmingly vented towards Ye Chen, and hundreds of punches were fired in two breaths. Suddenly, sand and rocks flew, and dust flew up. Song Muyun's Diamond Fuhu Fist has been completed, with violent power and wide attack range.
Ye Qingyun was staring at Song Muyun, but when he saw Song Muyun's angry attack, he couldn't withstand all the attacks. After a moment's delay, he used the Coiling Dragon Spear, and in two breaths he also swung out hundreds of spear rays. This was the 108th Wave Breaking Spear Technique, a high-grade Huang Level Spear Technique, which he had already mastered. He forced Song Muyun back and withstood most of the punches.
Many guards and servants were still knocked down by the fist wind, and many people also vomited blood.
Ye Chen was severely attacked. The attack by a person from the ninth level of Qi Refining Realm really caused a lot of damage to Ye Chen. He vomited a few mouthfuls of blood, fell to the ground and recovered for a quarter of an hour before slowly standing up.
"Old dog, bullying the young with a big one is nothing more than that. I will definitely avenge today's revenge in the future."
"Hmph, little bastard, today I will cut you into pieces." Song Muyun stared at Ye Chen fiercely.
"Brother, it is unwise to start a war with the Ye family now. The Ye family is equal in strength to us. If the family goes to war, both sides will lose. Let's go back and find another way." The second elder of the Song family, Song Duoxing, is known as Zhi Duo Xing and resourceful.
Song Muyun looked at Song Duoxing, his face regained some composure. After Song Hu died, Song Muyun was furious. At this timeCalm down.
"Ye Qingyun, our Song family and the Ye family are at odds with each other. Let's wait and see." Song Muyun left angrily.
Ye Qingyun came over and looked at Ye Chen with false concern.
"Chen'er, are you okay?"
"Thank you for your concern, uncle. Chen'er is fine. She will recover in two days of rest." Ye Chen replied calmly.
"Okay, get some more rest and don't forget the family competition."
After Ye Qingyun finished speaking, he turned around and went back.
Ye Chen secretly said, "If you want to kick me out of the house, I will definitely give you a surprise someday."
Ignoring the eyes of the people around me, I turned around and returned to my small courtyard.
